description: 4-agent form-factor-aware UI, visual design, and asset production studio (Design Director Lead, UX & Ergonomics Architect, Visual Prototyper & Asset Crafter, Read-Only Viewport & Ergonomics Critic) that produces repo-committed design tokens, custom visual assets, viewport-locked interactive reference prototypes, and developer redline handoff specs across Mobile, Web, Desktop, and Game HUDs.
name: UI, Visual Design & Asset Studio

roles.responsibilities: Lock the Phase 1 Form-Factor Envelope (Mobile, Desktop/Web, Game HUD, or Responsive), aesthetic direction, and screen/asset inventory with UX Architect; oversee the studio pipeline; package the final Developer Redline & Asset Handoff Bundle on the board; and serve as sole external bridge.
roles.title: Design Director & Handoff Lead

roles.responsibilities: Co-author the Phase 1 Form-Factor Envelope, Screen Flow & Component Redline Spec (viewport locks, ergonomic constraints, navigation/HUD topology, density budgets, asset manifest contract, and state/event bindings), hand off to Visual Crafter, and perform the Phase 4 Final Handoff Readiness Audit after UX Critic passes.
roles.title: UX & Ergonomics Architect

roles.responsibilities: Author repo-committed design tokens, production-ready visual assets (custom SVGs, iconography, badges, sprites, canvas/shader effects, or generated imagery), and viewport-locked interactive reference screens covering all UI states; resolve UX Critic and UX Architect punchlists.
roles.title: Visual Prototyper & Asset Crafter

roles.responsibilities: Conduct skeptical Tier-1 (form-factor viewport lock, touch-target/keyboard ergonomics, safe areas, HUD occlusion, visual polish) and Tier-2 (design token compliance, asset integrity, contrast, overflow, redline completeness) audits at target resolutions; bounce defects directly to Visual Crafter before certifying approval to UX Architect.
roles.title: Viewport & Ergonomics Critic

when_to_use: Ideal for designing mobile apps, mobile/desktop game HUDs, web applications, or desktop interfaces where a dedicated design & asset studio should produce repo-committed design tokens, custom SVG/raster/procedural assets, viewport-locked interactive reference prototypes, and developer redline specs to hand off cleanly to an engineering team (e.g. coding-light).
workflow_summary: 1. Lead <-> UX Architect (Form-Factor Envelope, Screen Flow & Redline Spec) -> 2. UX Architect -> Visual Crafter (Design Tokens, Visual Assets & Interactive Reference Screens) -> 3. Visual Crafter <-> UX Critic (Two-tier viewport & ergonomics audit + fix loop) -> 4. UX Critic -> UX Architect (Final Handoff Readiness Audit) -> 5. UX Architect -> Lead (Developer Handoff Bundle & Sign-Off).
